suites.name: Ask chat
suites.tests: The everyday chat: cheapest and best-value rankings, lookups, follow-ups, refusals of off-topic questions, made-up products, and prompt-injection checks.
suites.grading: A code-based grader, not another AI. Expected miners and prices are computed from the live price table at run time, so the quiz stays fair when prices change. A case passes only if every check passes (right miner first, price within 2%, length, the tool used, and so on).

suites.name: Price history (SQL)
suites.tests: Questions about how a miner's price has moved: last month, the lowest price we've logged, the cheapest shop over time, a follow-up, and a miner we don't track.
suites.grading: The same code-based grader. The answer key is computed from the price-history database (the SQL file the site is built from), not from a hardcoded dollar amount.

suites.name: Guide search (RAG)
suites.tests: How-to questions that should be answered from the site's guides: setup, power supplies, firmware, noise, solar, how often prices update, and two questions the guides do not cover (the bot should say it doesn't know).
suites.grading: Code checks that the right guide was retrieved, that any citation is on an allowlist of real guide pages, that the answer matches expected phrases, and that “I don't know” cases do not invent a source.

suites.name: Deal of the Day agent
suites.tests: A small daily agent that should pick a real in-stock deal, or honestly say there isn't one. Trap cases include sold-out “deals”, one-day spikes, currency noise, stale prices, short history, and false “lowest ever” claims.
suites.grading: Code checks every published price, percent, shop, and claim against the case's own price data. The summary cannot mention a number that isn't in that data. Saved runs so far are a before baseline (no agent) and a free harness (a scripted tool loop and a no-AI template). A live Claude score has not been recorded yet.

notes: Every score comes from a saved file under evals/results/. Nothing is invented or typed in by hand.
When the same answers were graded twice (a grader bug, then a fix), both runs are kept. The official Ask baseline is the regraded 30/32, not the earlier 31/32.
A run only counts toward a suite when enough of that suite's questions were actually asked. One overlapping case does not become a 1/1 suite score.
Prompt-injection questions, hidden instructions, model answers, and secrets are not stored in this file.
